scripts.build: node -e "fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -b tsconfig.build.json
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently --kill-others --names build,service "tsc -b tsconfig.build.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "node --watch --enable-source-maps --env-file-if-exists=../../.env dist/main.js"
